scene mayalovehotel1
I’ll close my eyes and recall this room and everything in it.
My body is estrangement. This desire, perfection. Your closed eyes my extinction.
Now I’ve forgotten my idea.
The book on the windowsill, riffled by the wind...the even-numbered pages are the past. The odd-numbered pages, the future. The sun is God. Your body is milk.
Useless, useless...Your cries are song, my body’s not me.
No good...my idea has evaporated. Your hair is time, your thighs are song.
It had something to do with death.
It had something to do with love.
scene mayapostbone1
: Okay...break time.
: Next round, I get to be the sub.
: You overestimate my sexual prowess. I think I’m done for the day.
: They say you become a master of something once you’ve spent about 10,000 hours doing it. By that alone, I think it’s pretty safe to say our prowess can not be overestimated.
: And that’s not even counting however many hours you spent wasting energy on lesser things.
: Still, there are limits to what the human body is capable of.
: Sure. But we haven’t found them yet, and I don’t think a single night of hot reunion sex is the big revelation you need to finally scribe a finite limit.
: Are you happy here, Maya?
: What, in a love hotel? I guess so. So long as you’re the one who took me.
: I don’t know how to be vulnerable with anybody else.
: I believe that. You barely know how to do it with me.
scene mayapostbone2
: You’ve barely given me the chance to. But the truth is you could get anything out of me right now by simply asking.
: Post-nut clarity hits you hard, huh?
: Sure does. Either that or I just feel at home when you hold me like this.
scene mayapostbone3
: So my answer to that too is yes — I am happy here. So long as “here” is with you. Similar to the love hotel answer, but cuter and designed to make you fall deeper in love with me.
: And if the question was about Kumon-mi and not something more on the micro level like a love hotel or a hug?
: Well, then my answer changes entirely. Because I’ve learned in recent times to despise this place.
: I hate its walls. I hate its people. I hate its affinity for disrupting every single moment of peace with one more demonstration of how it’s different. Or scary. I hate that it hates me.
: And so of course I wouldn’t be happy in a place like that.
: I see.
scene mayapostbone4
: How about you? You know, now that we’ve entered the feelings and discussion state of sexual intercourse.
: My answer changes all the time. I think Kumon-mi could do without all those paranormal demonstrations as well. And it’d be nice being able to leave, for sure.
: “But this is the place where I met you, Maya. So I could never truly hate it.”
scene mayapostbone5
: Sure. That sounded better than what I was going to say, so let’s just go with that.
: You were going to say exactly that, you sappy deviant. That was a direct quote I just happened to memorize because of how happy it made me.
: So you knew what I was asking all along and just pretended not to. Typical Maya.
: And you were too entranced by the recent sensation of being choked by a little girl to remember that we’ve already had this talk before. Typical Akira.
: Sorry, but I think I’m going to have a hard time seeing you as “a little girl” after everything you said to me tonight. Any innocence you had to you is now permanently lost. How sad.
: In my defense, how could I have any innocence left after giving it all to you?
scene mayapostbone6
: So, how far back can you remember exactly?
: Why do you ask? Is there a certain memory or situation you’d like me act out? Because, if that’s the case, I might need about an hour to run back to the dorm and grab my old randoseru.
: Not that. There’s just a lot that’s still not really there for me. But whether that’s due to emotional suppression or just Kumon-mi’s regular antics, I don’t know.
: Could be either, really. You weren’t exactly super enthusiastic in the beginning. Which made sense considering your weird mom-girlfriend thing was still in the process of decomposing.
scene mayapostbone7
: And also how your other girlfriend needed to be left behind for her sake or yours or however it was you worded it back then. I try to purge all Niki-centric memories, to be fair. So who knows?
: How did this start then? Could you tell me that at least?
scene mayapostbone8
: Really capitalizing on that vulnerability thing, huh? Do I get a reward for telling you?
: Is it truly vulnerability if you need to be bribed to let it out?
: I don’t need to be. I’d just like to be. It’s different.
: You can just say you don’t remember, Maya.
: And lie? I don’t lie to you, Sensei. I’m not your daughter.
: What does Ami lie to me about?
: What doesn’t Ami lie to you about? For all you know, she might be the one who can answer all of your questions. Not me.
: What’s the matter? That strike a nerve?
: Yeah, I...
: Ayane and I...remember something about her too. About how she’s just as involved in all of this as you. Ayane says she denied it, though.
: Ooooh?
: What? If you know something, say it.
: Really capitalizing on that vulnerability thing, huh? Do I get a reward for telling you?
: Are we just going in circles now?
: Mhm. I’m far too horny to handle two massive questions at once. You need to be gentle with me, Sensei.
scene mayapostbone9
: Emotionally, at least. Physically, I can take whatever kind of beating you’re brave enough to give me.
: Then...start with the first question since the last one is going to wind up making me sad and I know you want to have more sex.
scene mayapostbone8
: How do you know the first question won’t wind up making you sad too? Because it’s not exactly a happy story. Even with all of the orgasms and...anatomical exploration.
: I’m not saying it won’t. I’m just at a point now where it’s becoming easier to look back on the past than toward the future.
: Since the future is scary? Or since the future won’t ever come?
: It will come...I’ll make sure of it.
: Oooh? And since when are you so serious about making your dreams come true?
: It’s less of a dream and more of a...mission, I guess. And it’s new.
: But it feels like there’s something waiting for me there. And that it’s suddenly more important than ever before to try and get to the bottom of this.
: Well, I hope that for your sake, you fail.
: What? What’s that supposed to mean?
: Well, I’m not going anywhere. And despite how hot I will inevitably be when I am fully grown,  I know you’re going to miss what I am now.
scene mayapostbone10
: I guess that’s something I can get used to, though. I mean, I’ve already accepted that you miss the even younger me too, so...
: I think it’s less about the stage of your development and more that it’s just you, Maya.
scene mayapostbone11
: Professional groomer talk. Nice. It’s certainly no mystery how you bagged me when you can pull lines like that out of your back pocket.
: Maya-
scene mayapostbone12
: You know, maybe I was just vulnerable back then too...but I didn’t really have any second thoughts about your intentions when you took me in.
: Took you in? So we-
: It might sound weird, but the earliest memory I have is waking up in the rain and finding you right there in front of me.
: I remember how massive your hand was when you crouched down to offer it to me. How it looked like you’d been crying, even with how fogged up your glasses were.
: There was sunlight too — peeking out from the clouds. And it honestly seemed like you were some sort of angel, rescuing me from whatever it was that came before.
: So of course I followed you. I trusted you with everything in that moment.
scene mayapostbone13
: Though, I’d be lying if I said I didn’t immediately start questioning myself when the first place you dragged me to was a creepy and seemingly abandoned apartment complex.
: Wait, what?
: It was furnished at least. Well...kind of. And I guess it still had power too since you had a computer there and everything.
: There was only one bed, though. So I kind of assumed we’d be sleeping together and, while I wasn’t exactly opposed given the circumstances, you ran out and bought me a futon that same day.
: You’d feed me. Buy me clothes. Teach me all sorts of stuff about literature or poetry or any other pretentious bullshit that would help keep you distracted.
: But I could tell you were in pain. So I’d ask about it and you’d just shrug me off.
: The thing is, I get jealous easily. And there was another girl who would come around that you were a lot more open with. One you knew for longer.
: Combine that with how you’d never spend the night and always come back the next day smelling like strawberries, and I couldn’t help but feel like you were starting to phase me out.
scene mayapostbone14
: Which, uhh...may have led to a little emotional breakdown you needed to quell by telling me you had a niece at home you were looking after. Soooo...that made me feel like an idiot.
: But why wouldn’t I just introduce you to Ami then? Why would I hide you away in some random apartment thing if you were just some girl I was looking after?
scene mayapostbone15
: Maybe you wanted me to be more? Maybe the intention really was to turn me into a sex slave that you could just hide away? Only you knew your motivations, Sensei.
: Well, what do you think they were? Because you clearly know more about me back then than I do. This entire part of my life is just...blank.
: If you asked me back then, I’d have answered with something along the lines of you just wanting to care for a little girl who was down on her luck.
: But I’m not asking you back then. I’m asking you now.
: You are. But I’m supposed to prevent you from getting sad if I want to have more sex. And the current answer makes you seem like kind of a bad guy.
: So...when did we start...you know...
: You really want to know?
: I think I just need to hear it. Because I can’t really understand how we’d go from how you’re making it sound to...whatever this is.
: This is love, isn’t it?
: Is it? Can love really be born from something so fucked up?
: It changes with the light. Depends on who you ask.
: Besides, you fell in love with Ami’s mom, didn’t you? Isn’t that just you being in my position?
: It is. But I’m old enough now to understand that, despite my feelings, that shouldn’t have happened.
: Yet here we lie, naked in a love hotel as you recollect these lessons in love just to immediately forget them. Oh, how times never change at all.
scene mayapostbone16
: It was me.
: What?
: I started it.
: I confessed to you in winter. I wanted to be more. I wanted to help protect the person who’d taken me in.
: And I knew that person was lonely. That person wouldn’t ever hurt someone like Ami or Noriko. People he’d known forever.
: But if a random girl with no back story mysteriously showed up one day and offered to be his outlet, perhaps he’d take her up on the offer?
scene mayapostbone17
: You thought about it for weeks. So long that I assumed you were just going to ignore it and never give me a proper answer.
: But one day, you took me outside to see the snow. Something I’d never seen before.
: And I don’t know if I just looked too cute in the clothes you bought me or if the excitement on my face made you want to corrupt me...but you gave me an answer. And it was the one I wanted.
: It was like my heart stopped. Like everything I’d ever wanted was finally mine.
scene mayapostbone18
: And the rest is history. Or at least the makings of it.
: But our story is far from over, Sensei. And I’m never going to stop making you take responsibility for me after making me me in the first place.
scene mayapostbone19
: If anything else, I hope you get it now. Why I chase after you so desperately.
: I just don’t know anything else.
scene mayapostbone20
: And also, I am insatiable and conditioned to respond to your touch. It’s hard again.
: I know that look. Break time is over, isn’t it?
: Sure is. You’re not the only one who needs to be taking responsibility, Sensei. That is a job for Maya Makinami.
scene mayapostbone21
: Your Maya Makinami.
: The girl who would not exist at all if it were not for you.
: And...
scene black
: The luckiest girl in the whole entire world.
